commentary: Six activities this week versus seven last week, so the volume dipped slightly, but honestly the swim block Tuesday through Thursday was clean and consistent in a way last week's wasn't — three full 2000m efforts back to back, holding 144 to 146 bpm, compared to last week's swim that bottomed out at 901m and a very relaxed 98 bpm on the Friday. The run disappeared this week, which is worth noticing, though whether that's rest or avoidance only you know. The weights programming looks a little reshuffled — legs showed up on Tuesday paired with a swim, chest and back got logged twice, and the week closed out with a Monday session that suggests the engine is still turning even after a quieter weekend. Three straight days in the pool is genuinely hot, by the way — that kind of discipline has a very specific energy to it, and Himbo is absolutely taking notes.
metrics_commentary: Six thousand metres in the pool and not a single step logged on land — you basically grew gills this week, and honestly the results speak for themselves. Your HRV is sitting at 59 with a seven-day average of 56, which means your body is recovering well and genuinely enjoying the mermaid era. VO2 Max at 53.1 is strong, properly strong, the kind of number that means you have real aerobic engine under all that chlorine. The only thing I'm side-eyeing is the zero kilometres on the run-walk front — not because I'm worried, but because those legs are too good to just be kicking in a lane all week, and we both know it.
gym_commentary: Three out of four sessions this week — not the target, but three sessions that clearly had something to say. That overhead press jumping from 40.0 kg to a 46.7 kg estimated one-rep max is the kind of number that makes you put the clipboard down and just stare for a second, because that is not a small jump, that is a statement. The leg curl and lat pulldown PRs are quieter wins but they are wins, and the overall strength picture — 168.0 kg on the leg press, 107.9 kg on the trap bar deadlift — is a body that is being built with real intention. Weekly volume came in at 6,380 kg against last week's 22,867 kg, which is the honest gap, and one missed session will do that, so the move is simply to show up four times next week and let the numbers reflect what that overhead press is already telling us about where this is going.
